== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Nicknamed "The Krug Lord" by the viewers after dying to Krugs against KT in LCK 2025 Road to MSI.
* Received a pet Krug during MSI 2025.
* His ID '''Doran''' comes from his solo queue ID (돌잔치때도란잡음).
* Reached 1000 LCK kills on August 3rd, 2023
** Was the 26th player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK, after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Smeb]], [[Ambition]], [[Sangyoon]], [[Deft]], [[Teddy]], [[Ruler]], [[Bdd]], [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)|Ghost]], [[Peanut]], [[Chovy]], [[Fly (Song Yong-jun)|Fly]], [[ShowMaker]], [[Kiin]], [[Aiming]], [[Rascal]], [[deokdam]], [[Canyon]], [[Cuzz]], [[Viper (Park Do-hyeon)|Viper]] and [[Gumayusi]]
** The fourth top laner (after [[Smeb]], [[Kiin]] and [[Rascal]]) to reach 1000 kills in the LCK
* Reached 1500 LCK kills on August 7th, 2025
** Was the 18th player to reach 1500 kills in the LCK.
** The second top laner after [[Kiin]] to reach 1500 kills in the LCK.
* Reached 300 wins in [[LCK]] on March 21st, 2024, becoming the 17th player to do so.
* Reached 400 wins in [[LCK]] on September 18, 2025, becoming the 12th player to do so.
* Reached 500 games in [[LCK]] on July 25, 2024, becoming the 18th player to do so.
**  Was the third top laner to reach 500 games in the LCK.
* Reached 600 games in [[LCK]] on August 27, 2025, becoming the 15th player to do so.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on May 02, 2025.
** Was the 20th player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK.
{{PlayerStatsTrivia}}
=== Individual Awards ===
* LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x4 (Summer 2022, Summer 2023, Summer 2024, LCK 2025)
* LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x3 (Spring 2020, Spring 2023, Spring 2024)
